description:
Rain sounds for sleep — one full hour of rain falling in a quiet garden, with flowing water nearby and soft birdsong in some segments. Pure nature sounds only: no music, no talking, no sudden noises.

What you'll hear:
• Light rain falling on garden leaves and water
• A gentle stream flowing throughout
• Birdsong in some segments

Mixed for deep sleep, relaxation, studying and focus. The picture stays on one calm scene from start to finish, with a slow fade in and a slow fade out, so nothing startles you awake.

Chapters:
00:00 Rain begins
20:00 Garden rain continues
40:00 Rain until the end

New pure nature sounds every Tuesday and Friday.

Sound credits:
"Stream / river water up close" by jackthemurray (CC0)
"Early morning Birdsong Leersum" by Tammo Heikens (CC BY-SA 3.0 NL)
